name: Camping Bergkristall
beschreibung: Camping Bergkristall is located in the village of Prägraten in East Tyrol's Virgental valley. Surrounded by the majestic peaks of the Venediger Group, the campsite sits at an elevation of approximately 1,300 metres. The site features level pitches for motorhomes and caravans with reliable electrical connections. A dedicated tent meadow is available for guests bringing their own camping gear. The sanitary facilities include underfloor heating and barrier-free access. Numerous hiking trails leading into the Hohe Tauern National Park start directly from here. In winter, nearby ski lifts provide easy access to downhill skiing.
